# skycloak_realm_roles (Data Source)

Realm-scoped roles in a realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_realm_roles" "all" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `client_role` (Boolean) Whether the role is client-scoped.
- `composite` (Boolean) Whether the role is composite.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `name` (String) Role name.
